analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($774.11) vs SMA5/20/50 ($831.58/$884.17/$923.06): Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, confirming bearish trend position.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($978.42/$947.88): Below long-term moving averages, indicating trend weakening.
· 52-week position (36.6%) + Approaching historical low vicinity.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (40.7→35.2): Entering oversold territory, confirming continued downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-5.5354→-9.7944): Bearish expansion, continued decline after dead cross.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Near lower band $762.04) + Bandwidth at 27.62%, indicating increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($617.11): Distant from current price, indicating weak short-term support.
· Swing Resistance ($846.00): Close to current price, potential resistance on short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low unconfirmed, potential Lower High): Signaling continued downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.43x vs 5-day average): Spike in volume, confirming selling pressure amidst decline.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend): Potential for further decline due to RSI oversold entry and MACD bearish expansion, maintain wait-and-see stance.
